description: Baseline harness failed because Modal returned an HTTP 303 redirect that the existing benchmark client does not follow

asi.hypothesis: The existing endpoint benchmark would provide a valid untouched SGLang baseline after redeployment.
asi.rollback_reason: The benchmark client treats Modal's expected 303 routing redirect as an API failure because curl does not follow redirects.
asi.next_action_hint: Before the first successful baseline, minimally add curl redirect following to benchmark_endpoint.sh, then freeze the harness.

description: Baseline rerun followed Modal redirect but the freshly recreated SGLang container returned HTTP 500 during startup

asi.hypothesis: Following redirects would make the existing benchmark client reach the freshly deployed SGLang server.
asi.rollback_reason: Redirect handling worked, but the deployment returned HTTP 500 before a valid warmup response; server logs are required.
asi.next_action_hint: Inspect full experiment and Modal app logs, fix deployment/startup root cause, then rerun baseline.

description: Established frozen SGLang FP16 single-T4 baseline and fixed Modal redirect handling in the benchmark client

asi.hypothesis: The untouched SGLang configuration provides a stable baseline once the benchmark follows Modal routing redirects and uses rolling deploys.
asi.baseline_note: Primary generated exactly 768 tokens; holdout generated 128, so token-count truncation is stable.
